asset_heavy.reason: Lab analysis, consulting and inspection services; relies on laboratories and equipment, not fleets or networks; moderately asset-light.

big_ticket.reason: Lab analyses, tracer diagnostics and inspections are routine, repeated, modest-sized service orders per job.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oil and gas operators cut reservoir studies, completions and drilling-related spending when oil prices fall.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are the world's leading energy companies, including national and international oil companies.

notes: Two segments, Reservoir Description and Production Enhancement; services dominate, with perforating and diagnostic products as the smaller part.

offers_products.reason: Production Enhancement sells proprietary products such as perforating charges, RDS system and tracer technologies.

offers_services.reason: Core and fluid analysis, consulting, Saybolt inspection and CCS characterization services are its main offerings.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from proprietary lab analysis, technology, data and products, though skilled scientists matter; not mainly staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Energy operators repeatedly order lab analysis, inspection and diagnostics; Saybolt inspections recur, though work is project-driven.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are oil and gas companies; no sales to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells reservoir analysis, products and inspection to energy companies and petroleum businesses.
